description:
Use this when the user compares an Indian company listed on NSE or BSE with similar companies on valuation, margins, return on capital or debt (PE, PB, ROE, debt-to-equity). For peers chosen by business, with reasons, use get_relevant_peers.

Returns a table of up to `limit` companies (default 8, at most 15), the company asked about among them, from the same SEBI industry and of similar size (between one-tenth and ten times its market cap, largest first), with the medians across the table. Columns, on a trailing-twelve-month basis: market cap, P/E, P/B, revenue, net and EBITDA margin, ROE, ROA, ROCE, interest coverage, debt to equity, enterprise-value multiples and cash-flow ratios. Peers are chosen by classification and size, not by how alike the businesses are: for peers with reasons use get_relevant_peers. To compare companies the user names, call get_financials or get_batch_quotes with those companies.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query
